text:
nina: Heads-up — MedAlign submitted an early renewal for their Private license and asked us to apply the new lower platform_fee immediately instead of at the next term start. Invoice INV-9344 shows the original rate for May. Link: https://invoices.internal/INV-9344 cc @frank

oscar: Got it. They signed early on 2026-09-02 with effective renewal term 10/01/2026. Their current billing period is 05/01 - 05/31, so the request is to backdate pricing to 05/15 when AE says they verbally committed to extend and get the promo.

frank: Sales notes: AE recorded "early renewal + promotional platform fee applied from mid-May" but no signed amendment in SFDC yet. Customer sent a PO referencing the new pricing on 2026-05-18.

tess: From billing system: 
```
INV-9344 lines:
platform_fee  18,000.00   05/01 - 05/31
private_license  18,000.00  annual 10/01/2026
```
Requested adjustment: apply promotional rate 15,300 (15% off) for remainder of current month starting 05/15 -> credit = (17/31 days) * (18000-15300) = pro-rate calc.

nina: Can we do a one-time true-up credit to reflect the promo from 05/15 forward? Legal says we need written confirmation. Customer has PO and AE email.

glen: Finance: Need approval for credits >$2k. Quick calc: delta = 2,700 annualized for the month; pro-rate days = 17/31 * 2,700 = 1,483.87 (rounding). Split GL: 4-115-PartnerCredits if partner influenced otherwise 4-100-PlatformCredits. Which GL?

frank: Partner wasn't involved — this was a direct AE promo. Use 4-100-PlatformCredits. Also note this is a non-recurring retro adjustment, not a change to invoice cadence.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach PO and AE confirmation email. If not signed addendum, include "non-precedent" clause in memo.

oscar: Approve one-time credit of $1,483.87 applied to INV-9344. GL 4-100-PlatformCredits. Add memo: "early renewal promo applied from 2026-05-15 per PO 5567 and AE confirmation. Non-precedent."

tess: Creating ADJ. Calculator: 17/31 * 2700 = 1483.87. ADJ-12011 created amount -1483.87 status: pending approval.

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-12011 amount: -1483.87 status: posted. Link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-12011

frank: Attached PO and AE email to ADJ. No cash refund; credit memo applied to INV-9344.

nina: I'll update renewal dashboard and flag this as an "early-renewal promo" for the pricing experiment. Please ensure sales uploads signed amendment for future terms. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
